# StartupOnX India
> India's curated startup directory. Founders pay Rs149/month to list their startup and get discovered by investors, users, and the founder community. No ranking by money. No algorithm.

## About
StartupOnX India (startuponx.com) is a directory of Indian startups building in public.
Categories: AI, SaaS, Fintech, Developer Tools, Design, Marketing, Productivity.
Pricing: Rs149/month (founding member), Rs299/month (standard).
Payment: UPI (GPay, PhonePe, Paytm).
Listings go live within 24 hours after manual review.
